title: •Coordinated Attack
caption: •Coordinated Attack (V)
game_text:
USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-{lightsaber} weapon, may place target (and all cards on it) in owner’s Used Pile.
LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn.

notes: Unique. Banner USED OR LOST INTERRUPT (printed base is a Used or Lost Interrupt). Inline icon in 'non-[icon] weapon' = black square with a green blade → {lightsaber} token per the brief (it is the Permanent Weapon icon — the PC's VB1 reissue reads 'non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon', the stub 'non-permanent-weapon'). Curly apostrophe in owner’s. USED:/LOST: on separate lines. No margin credits. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes (wiki straight single quotes). Copyright Special Edition form, 1998. Base scan 350 px only. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1-D-coordinatedattack-pre.gif, 350 px).
